_comment: Source of truth for adapters/cursor/mcp.json. Add stdio servers with `python3 policy/pack.py add-mcp NAME -- cmd args` (always wrapped). `make mcp` / `make install-cursor` regenerates Cursor config. HTTP/plugin servers cannot be wrapped by -stdio; stream A either reverse-proxies them or re-registers them as a custom URL.

atlassian.note: Cursor Atlassian plugin (plugin-atlassian-atlassian) is ungoverable: gurdy-proxy never sees that channel. adapters/cursor/http-proxy.sh is the reverse-proxy hop; set wrap=true only after pointing Cursor at http://127.0.0.1:18090/v2/mcp AND a tools/call appears in ~/.gurdy/ledger/atlassian/. OAuth that only works inside the plugin keeps this identity-hook-only.

filesystem.note: Demo target. Credential-read and destructive-fs rules fire on this server's tools/call traffic.
